changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla learning_paths: rutas de aprendizaje de un curso con sus umbrales (brief: Ruta). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría learning_paths_audit y el trigger learning_paths_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Learning paths of a course with their approval thresholds

column.name: default_objective
column.remarks: Default learning objective of the path

column.name: topic_pass_threshold
column.remarks: Minimum percentage to pass a topic quiz

column.name: final_pass_threshold
column.remarks: Minimum percentage to pass the final assessment and earn the badge

column.name: mastery_skip_threshold
column.remarks: Diagnostic percentage from which a topic is skipped

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_thresholds_ck CHECK (topic_pass_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND final_pass_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND mastery_skip_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_max_attempts_ck CHECK (max_attempts >= 1)

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in learning_paths

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_paths_audit ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER learning_paths_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON learning_paths FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS learning_paths_audit_trg ON learning_paths
